ModMetaData.name: Persona Weapons Unbound
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Customize Royalty's persona weapons at a fabrication bench: add and remove bladelink traits, convert base weapons to and from their persona variants with a persona core, rename, and recolor. Gated behind research and an Empire techprint. Craft base monoswords, plasmaswords, and zeushammers. Configurable trait costs. Requires Royalty.
